title: CodeFlow Session Artifact (MCP submit_flow_draft -> Fusion contract)
$comment: Ticket 03. E2 channel: agent journey draft via MCP structured submission (transcript parsing is out of scope, R7/R12).
description: REJECTION CONTRACT (normative): a draft step WITHOUT a verified anchor is schema-invalid — CORE must reject the whole artifact and park it as 'unlinked' (design §12). anchorsMustPassVerification is a const true: submissions cannot opt out of anchor re-verification; Fusion adopts only drafts whose anchors pass the R3 relink check. A journeyDraft identifies its flow either by an existing flowIdRef or by proposedEntrySymbolPath for analyze_flow-style new entries — at least one MUST be present.

artifactId.description: 'art-' + first 16 lowercase-hex chars of sha256(sessionId + submittedAt + firstStepAnchorSpanHash); collision suffix rule as flowId.

allOf.description: Every draft step REQUIRES a full R3 anchor: an unanchored step makes this document invalid and the artifact is rejected as 'unlinked'.

rationale.description: Why the agent asserts this step belongs to the journey.

anchorsMustPassVerification.description: Cannot be false. Fusion re-verifies every submitted anchor against the current worktree before adoption.
